title: Generation of mouse bone marrow-derived macrophages \(BM-MFs)
protocol: Flush mouse tibiae and femurs with ice-cold PBS through a 70 μm-wide cut-off cell strainer.
Resuspend pelleted cells in conditioned medium supplemented with 30% of growth supernatant from M-CSF-transduced L929 cells.
Seed 7 x 10^6 cells in a 100 x 20 mm non-treated cell culture plate using 10 ml of conditioned medium.
Split adhered cells and seed 5 x 10^6 cells in a new 100 x 20 mm non-treated cell culture plate when the cells reach confluence, approximately after 7 days.
Seed cells using 10 ml of conditioned medium for each new plate.
BMMFs are ready for experimental use when the percentage of CD11b+ cells is higher than 90%, as measured by FACS analysis.
